Name: Colored Slime and Slime Produce
Author: TerryDBS
Description:
Originally known as ""Pudding Plus," This mod adds slime item variants, and the ability to make gelatin from them, which you can use to make pudding using a little barbershop pole style machine. Simply right click on it, and it'll open up a menu to craft pudding. If it already has ingredients in it, you can hold shift to immediately start producing.

Pudding value is based off every ingredient you use in it- up to four "flavor" ingredients in the top row, and up to three other ingredients (milk, gelatin and sugar, up to one of each) in the bottom row.

You need at least one item in the top and bottom rows to make a pudding. The value of the pudding is equal to three times the average of the items value, plus 50. It inherits quality from its ingredients, and can have its value boosted further by using better gelatin and adding milk and/or sugar.

This mod also adds new slime variants, which can be obtained via the Advanced Slime Egg Press you unlock at level 8 Combat. You can combine 50 pieces of two basic slime colors to obtain a patterned slime egg in it. Currently, the following combinations exist:

Green: +Blue = Planet, +Yellow = Galaxy
Blue: +Purple = Aurora
Red: +Normal = Bunny, +Yellow = Solar
Purple: +Yellow = Fairy
Medley: +Yellow = Ivory (Heads up, you shouldn't hatch this egg until you get the Slime Charmer ring. This one's angry.)

Gelatin can be made it using the Gelatin Condenser using 10 slime of any type.

There are 8 hidden "hybrid" fruit puddings that require specific recipes. Try to find them all by experimenting! The first person to show me all 8 recipes will get to decide the 9th.

Versions prior to the current one do not work with the most recent version of Stardew Valley. Update as soon as possible.

Credit to Wally32 for the mod the original version is based on, linked here.
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7003
